reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the next renewal at Brackenwater Freight Co. is on 10 June.

- On the 14th, Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team.
- Later that day she corrected it in #north-random: the date is 10 June, and she'd read the wrong line the first time. Marcus is a member of #north-random, so he can see that correction himself.
- I found no Brackenwater files in the shared folders, so I couldn't check the date against a contract.
- The knowledge brain (gbrain) refused the search because its access token isn't tied to any member, so it returned nothing.
- My 14 October reply in #north-team still repeats Ilse's 25 November date and hasn't been corrected there.
